Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ProcessModelOperatingActionSetEvaluator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelOperatingActionSetEvaluator
public final class ProcessModelOperatingActionSetEvaluator extends Object
Evaluates an ordered set of reversible operating actions as one steady-state transaction.

Every action state is captured before the first write. Candidate values are then applied in declaration order. If a later action is rejected, every captured action is restored in reverse order and the process-model evaluator is not run at the partial candidate. A complete candidate is simulated once, exact required hydraulic constraints are snapshotted, and every action is restored in reverse order before the baseline is rerun.

The action-set identifier, name, provenance, ordered action definitions, per-action write/read-back evidence, objective and constraint arrays, hydraulic and complete installed-capacity evidence, restoration status, and diagnostics are retained in an immutable serializable result suitable for JPype/Python. Action identifiers and automation addresses must be unique so one transaction cannot write the same control target twice under different metadata.

This class composes existing NeqSim actions, process runs, and equipment constraints. It does not solve allocation, change routing or topology, add hydraulic correlations, or constitute operating or safety approval. Calls mutate the supplied model and are synchronized; use independent ProcessModel instances for parallel candidates.

  • Constructor Details

    • ProcessModelOperatingActionSetEvaluator

      public ProcessModelOperatingActionSetEvaluator(String id, String name, String provenance, ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator evaluator, List<ProcessModelOperatingAction> actions)
      Creates a coupled transactional evaluator and registers enabled equipment capacities.
      Parameters:
      id - stable action-set identifier
      name - human-readable action-set name
      provenance - engineering source for treating the actions as one candidate
      evaluator - configured evaluator with objectives, optional non-equipment constraints, and no parameters
      actions - non-empty ordered action list with unique IDs and automation addresses
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid metadata, actions, duplicate IDs, or duplicate addresses
      IllegalStateException - if the evaluator has no model or already has parameters
